interface.signature: def isMatch(s: str, p: str) -> bool

preconditions.description: Both s and p must be strings.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in s) and all(c.islower() or c in '*?' for c in p)
preconditions.description: s contains only lowercase letters, and p contains only lowercase letters, '*' or '?'.

postconditions.description: The function returns True if the pattern p can match the entire string s, otherwise False.
